summary: ansible.windows warns when setup runs on Server 2012/2012 R2 and deprecated win_domain, win_domain_controller and win_domain_membership in favour of microsoft.ad modules, removal in 3.0.0.
questions: Should I use microsoft.ad.domain instead of win_domain?
Why does setup warn on Windows 2012?

answer_card.title: ansible.windows domain modules → microsoft.ad
answer_card.answer_md:
Deprecated in ansible.windows (removed in **3.0.0**):

- `win_domain` → **`microsoft.ad.domain`**
- `win_domain_controller` → **`microsoft.ad.domain_controller`**
- `win_domain_membership` → **`microsoft.ad.membership`**

`setup` also warns on Server 2012 / 2012 R2 (nearing EOL).
